description: C47 — 完美协调模型：每子角色清晰

intro.popup_en: Piece Coordination, Lesson 5: The Four Knights Game is a useful model for coordinated development, with all four minor pieces developed by both sides.
intro.popup:
子力协调第5课
四马开局是很好的协调步调，各4个轻子全出！

outro.popup_en: Nf5 is the culmination of the coordinated attack. Every move contributed to the same plan: pressure Black's kingside.
outro.popup:
总结：Nf5是协调攻击的顶点
每步棋都推进了同一计划：攻击黑方王翼

moves.popup_en: e4 opens the game.
moves.popup: e4开局

moves.popup_en: ...e5 mirrors White's move.
moves.popup: e5对称

moves.popup_en: Nf3 develops White's first knight, controlling e5 and d4.
moves.popup:
Nf3第1马
控制e5/d4

moves.popup_en: ...Nc6 develops Black's first knight and protects e5.
moves.popup:
Nc6第1马
保护e5

moves.popup_en: Nc3 develops White's second knight. Together, Nf3 and Nc3 coordinate around the center in the Four Knights Game.
moves.popup:
Nc3第2马
四马开局第2步
协调：Nf3+Nc3双马联动控中心

moves.popup_en: ...Nf6 develops Black's second knight. Both sides have developed two knights.
moves.popup:
Nf6黑方第2马
四马出齐！双方各有2匹马

moves.popup_en: Bb5! White pins Nc6 and disrupts Black's coordination. This is a classic way to interfere with the opponent's piece setup.
moves.popup:
Bb5！白方策略：牵制
激活：象出动牵制Nc6
计划：Bb5使Nc6"哑火"，破坏黑方协调
这是主动破坏对方协调的典型手法！

moves.popup_en: ...Bb4! Black counter-pins Nc3, interfering with White's central control. The mutual pins create a complex coordination battle.
moves.popup:
Bb4！黑方反牵制
激活：黑方象反牵制Nc3
协调：Bb4牵制Nc3，破坏白方中心控制
互相牵制：最复杂的协调对抗！

moves.popup_en: O-O secures White's king and activates the rook on f1. White stabilizes before committing to a plan.
moves.popup:
O-O白方易位
激活：Rf1进入游戏
计划：先稳定，让黑方先表态

moves.popup_en: ...O-O also secures Black's king. Both sides are ready for a coordination battle.
moves.popup:
O-O黑方也易位
双方王安全，进入协调大战

moves.popup_en: d3 stabilizes the center and prepares a knight maneuver Ne2-g3-f5 against Black's king.
moves.popup:
d3稳固
激活：为Ne2做准备
计划：Ne2→Ng3→Nf5攻王路线开始！

moves.popup_en: ...d6 reinforces Black's center.
moves.popup: d6黑方守中心

moves.popup_en: Ne2! White begins a knight maneuver from c3 toward g3 and then h5 or f5. Though it looks like a retreat, it is a transfer to the kingside. The bishop on b5 and knight maneuver serve complementary roles.
moves.popup:
Ne2！马开始机动
激活：马从c3移到e2
⚠️ 看起来像退步，实际是攻击路线中转站
计划：Ne2→Ng3→Nh5或Nf5进攻王翼
协调：Bb5（牵制Nc6）+ Ne2（机动进攻）联合

moves.popup_en: ...Ne7 reroutes Black's knight as well.
moves.popup:
Ne7黑方马退守
黑方马也开始机动

moves.popup_en: c3 challenges the bishop and aims to make it leave the pin on Nc3. Once it retreats, White's knight regains its full central influence.
moves.popup:
c3逼象表态
激活：逼迫Bb4离开牵制位
计划：Bb4一旦撤退，Nc3控制力恢复

moves.popup_en: ...Ba5 retreats the bishop and gives up the pin, losing some initiative.
moves.popup:
Ba5黑方象撤退
黑方象退出牵制，但失去主动

moves.popup_en: Ng3! The knight heads toward the kingside, coordinating with h4-h5 while Bb5 continues to pin Nc6. The route to f5 is ready.
moves.popup:
Ng3！马到达g3！
激活：马向王翼推进
协调：Ng3（准备h4-h5推进）+ Bb5（牵制Nc6）
计划：Ng3准备跳f5，攻击黑方王翼！

moves.popup_en: ...c6 counterattacks the bishop on b5 and asks it to choose a square.
moves.popup:
c6黑方反击Bb5
黑方翼兵推进，逼Bb5表态

moves.popup_en: Ba4 retreats again while maintaining pressure on Nc6. The bishop's pin and knight's kingside attack remain separate, complementary tasks.
moves.popup:
Ba4象再退
激活：象仍然牵制黑方Nc6→c6
协调：Ba4（牵制）+ Ng3（攻王）两翼互不干扰

moves.popup_en: ...Ng6 defends the kingside and prepares to meet h5.
moves.popup:
Ng6黑方防守
黑方马到g6，准备防守h5

moves.popup_en: h4! White advances the h-pawn with Ng3's support. The plan h4-h5 restricts the knight on g6 and helps ensure Nf5 cannot be captured by it.
moves.popup:
h4！兵推进！
激活：h兵推进，配合Ng3
协调：h4+Ng3协同推进
计划：h4-h5限制g6马的退路，让Nf5无法被马吃

moves.popup_en: ...h6 reinforces the defense of h5 and tries to stop White's pawn advance.
moves.popup:
h6黑方防守h5
黑方试图阻止h5推进

moves.popup_en: h5! White keeps pressing and restricts the knight on g6. Together with Ng3, the pawn supports the coming Nf5; Black's knight is now cramped.
moves.popup:
h5！继续压！
激活：h5兵压制g6马
协调：h5（压制g6马）+ Ng3（准备Nf5）联合
黑方Ng6已经被封锁！

moves.popup_en: ...Nf4 counterattacks and targets White's knight on g3.
moves.popup:
Nf4黑方马出击
黑方马反扑，攻击Ng3

moves.popup_en: Bxf4 removes the counterattacking knight, clearing the way for Ng3 to reach f5.
moves.popup:
Bxf4换掉黑马
激活：换掉反扑的Nf4
计划：清除障碍，让Ng3可以进入f5

moves.popup_en: ...exf4 recaptures and restores the material balance.
moves.popup:
exf4黑方吃回
黑方重新夺回格子

moves.popup_en: Nf5! The knight reaches its strongest attacking square. The coordinated model is complete: Nf5 occupies the outpost, Ba4 pins a defender, Rf1 controls the f-file, and the h5-pawn restrains Ng6. Four forces combine against Black's king.
moves.popup:
Nf5！马进驻f5！！
激活：马到达最强攻击格！
协调完美模型最终形成：
🐴 Nf5（进驻f5强格）
🏹 Ba4（牵制黑方援兵）
🏰 Rf1（控制f列）
♟♟ h5兵（封锁g6马）
✅ 四子联合攻击黑王——这就是完美协调！
